# Baby Shark Bubble Bath, 8 oz

Turn bath time into a splashing adventure with the Baby Shark Bubble Bath. This officially licensed 8 oz bottle brings your child's favorite character into the tub, so every wash feels like playtime.

## Rich, Long-Lasting Bubbles for Everyday Baths

Its mild, gentle formula whips up full, lasting bubbles that delight kids from the first splash. Because it's gentle enough for daily use, you can keep bath time a cheerful part of the routine.

## Fresh Ocean Berry Scent Kids Love

The sweet ocean berry fragrance leaves every bath smelling fresh from head to toe. Your little one climbs out clean, bubbly, and ready for bedtime stories.

## Ingredients Parents Can Feel Good About

Formulated without parabens or BPA, this bubble bath lets you choose a product you can feel good about while your kids play.

## Make Bath Night the Highlight

Add Baby Shark Bubble Bath to your cart now and turn ordinary bath nights into the best part of your child's day.

---

I wrote this from the title and feature list. The source description says "Frozen," which conflicts with the Baby Shark title, so I left the character unnamed. Check the brand and character before publishing.
